privacy.title: Sirri
privacy.lead: Babu talla, babu bincike, babu bin diddigi, babu asusu. Alƙur'ani, zikirai da lokutan salla suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba; ana amfani da intanet don karatu, rediyo, hadisai da ƙarin mushafai da tafsirai.
privacy.collectText: Babu komai. Ba ma karɓar wani bayanin sirri ko na amfani.
privacy.deviceTitle: Abin da ke zama a na'urarka
privacy.deviceText: Saitunanka, zikiranka, tsarin jeri, ƙirgar yau da kullum, ma'aunan tasbihi da ƙididdiga. Cire manhajar na goge su. An kashe madadin girgije na Android.
privacy.permissionsText: Intanet don karatu da rediyo da kake kunnawa, hadisai (hadisin yau da wanda ka buɗe ko ka nema) da ƙarin mushafai da tafsirai da ka sauke; nunawa a kan wasu manhajoji da sabis na gaba (sai idan ka kunna katin ko ma'auni mai iyo); sanarwa don tunatarwa; farawa lokacin kunna waya don dawo da su; girgiza don ƙirga.
privacy.locationText: Kawai idan ka zaɓi wuri na atomatik don lokutan sallah: ana karanta shi sau ɗaya, ana kusantar da shi zuwa kimanin kilomita 1, ana ajiye shi a na'ura kuma ba a taɓa raba shi ba. Kana iya zaɓar birni maimakon haka.
privacy.backupText: Fitarwa tana ƙirƙirar fayil ta buɗe zaɓin rabawa. Kai ne ka zaɓi inda zai je; manhajar ba ta ɗora komai. Tushen intanet (everyayah.com, mp3quran.net, hadeethenc.com, dorar.net, jsDelivr, quran.com, archive.org) suna karɓar buƙatar fayil ko hadisi kawai, ba komai game da kai ba.

hifz.emptyTitle: Gina dangantaka mai ɗorewa da Alƙur'ani
hifz.emptyBody: Zaɓi sashe, haddace 'yan ayoyi kowace rana, kuma kunna bibiya don maimaita su a tazara mai ƙaruwa. Kana iya samun shirye-shirye da yawa masu launuka daban-daban.
hifz.none: Babu sabbin ayoyi da suka rage
hifz.name: Sunan shiri
hifz.error: Ba a iya ajiye ko loda shirin ba. Duba sashen ka sake gwadawa.

location.failed: Wayar ba ta iya gano wuri yanzu ba. Matsa kusa da taga ko ka kunna Wi-Fi ka sake gwadawa, ko ka zaɓi birni daga jerin.
location.denied: Ba a ba da izinin shiga wuri ba. Ba da izini a saitunan manhajar ko ka zaɓi birni daga jerin.
location.off: Kunna wuri a wayarka, sannan ka sake taɓa "Gano wurina da kanta".

calendar.title: Lokutan Musulunci
calendar.offsetHint: Idan a ƙasarku wata yana farawa kwana ɗaya kafin ko bayan kalandar Ummul Ƙura saboda ganin wata, gyara a nan.
calendar.note: Kwanakin suna bin kalandar Ummul Ƙura tare da gyaranka; ainihin farkon kowane wata yana bin ganin wata a ƙasarku.
calendar.lastThird: Kashi na uku na ƙarshen dare
calendar.fastingReminderHint: Da yamma kafin Arafa, Ashura, kwanaki fararu da sauransu.

calendar.lastThirdHelp: Ana lissafa daga Magariba zuwa Asuba. Yana aiki ko da kiran sallah a kashe yake.

editions.title: Mushafai da Kira'o'i
editions.intro: Zaɓi mushafin da shafin Alƙur'ani zai buɗe. Mushafan da aka sauke suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
editions.riwayatIntro: Rubutu da shafukan kowace riwaya kamar yadda Cibiyar Sarki Fahd ta Madina ta buga.
editions.tenQiraatHint: Karatuttuka a cikin riwayoyi da yawa na makaranta goma: Warsh, Qalun, Khalaf, ad-Duri, Hisham, Ibn Dhakwan, Ruways da Rawh, Ibn Jammaz...
editions.credit: Rubutun riwayoyi da haruffansu: Cibiyar Sarki Fahd ta Buga Alƙur'ani. Launukan tajwidi da shafukan Shamarly: quran.com · archive.org

desc.hafs: Mushafin Madina da ke cikin manhaja, shafuka 604, tare da dukkan siffofi: tafsiri, karatu, alamomi da bayanai.
desc.tajweed: Shafukan Mushafin Madina tare da ƙa'idodin tajwidi a launi (madd, ghunna, ikhfa, idgham, iqlab, qalqala); dukkan siffofi suna aiki.
desc.images: Mushafin Shamarly na Masar (shafuka 522) kamar yadda aka buga. Ana loda shafuka daga intanet, ko ka ajiye su duka.
desc.riwaya: Karanta Alƙur'ani da wannan riwaya, da rubutunta da lambobin shafukanta.

hadith.title: Hadisai
hadith.bundled: Yana nan ba tare da intanet ba
hadith.downloadToRead: Sauke wannan tarin don karantawa ba tare da intanet ba.
hadith.searchHelp: Nema cikin Larabci da fassarorin da ke na’ura. Rubuta aƙalla haruffa biyu.
hadith.downloadHelp: Za a sauke Larabci, Turanci da harshenka idan akwai. Ba a sauke wani tari kai tsaye.
hadith.languageMissing: Harshenka yana nan amma ba a sauke shi ba tukuna.
hadith.numbering: Lambobi suna bin bugun tushe kuma suna iya bambanta da littattafan da aka buga.
hadith.bookmarkHelp: Ana haɗa alamomin shafi da bayananka cikin ajiyar madadin na’ura.
hadith.loadFailed: An kasa loda hadisin. Sake gwadawa.
hadith.downloadFailed: Saukewa ya gaza. Duba haɗin intanet da sararin ajiya, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
hadith.actionFailed: An kasa kammala aikin. Sake gwadawa.
hadith.notFound: Ba a sami wannan hadisin cikin littafin ba.
hadith.fallback: Ana nuna fassarar Turanci; babu wannan hadisin a harshenka.
hadith.rulingQuestion: Wa ya ruwaito wannan hadisin? Sahihi ne ko mai rauni, kuma me ya sa?
hadith.notRecorded: Ba a ambata a wannan tushe ba
hadith.gradeCaution: Ma’anar daraja tana bayyana rukuni gaba ɗaya, ba takamaiman dalilin hukuncin malami kan wannan ruwayar ba.
hadith.onlineHelp: Cikakken hukunci yana buƙatar intanet. Ana iya karanta wanda aka ajiye ba tare da intanet ba.
hadith.onlineUnavailable: Ba a samu hukuncin intanet ba. Haɗa intanet ka sake gwadawa; bayanan da ke na’ura suna sama.
hadith.noMatch: Ba a sami rubutun da ya yi kama sosai ba. Ba a jingina darajar waɗannan sakamakon ga hadisin ba.
hadith.matchNotice: Waɗannan hukunce-hukuncen Larabci sun yi kusa da rubutun. Kwatanta ruwayar da madogararta; sanadodi daban na iya samun hukunci daban.

meanings.sahih: Sanadi mai haɗewa na amintattun masu ruwaya masu ƙwaƙwalwa mai kyau, ba tare da saɓani ko ɓoyayyen aibi ba.
meanings.hasan: Sanadi mai haɗewa kuma abin karɓa; daidaiton wani mai ruwaya bai kai matakin sahihi ba.
meanings.daif: Ba a cika sharuɗɗan inganci ba, kamar yankewar sanadi ko raunin mai ruwaya. Ana samun takamaiman dalili a hukuncin malami.
meanings.mawdu: Labarin da aka ƙirƙira aka jingina shi ga Annabi ﷺ da ƙarya.
meanings.unknown: Babu rarrabawa mai sauƙi. Karanta ainihin kalmomin hukuncin malami da tushensa.

wbw.englishFallback: Babu ma'anonin kalmomi da harshenka tukuna, don haka ana nuna su da Turanci. Kana iya zaɓar wani harshe a sama.
